defects.note: TO_DATE with nested commas in its single argument, three blocks deep; marker on the TO_DATE line
single-argument TO_TIMESTAMP on its own line inside a multi-line INSERT
VARCHAR2 parameter compared with a NUMBER local; the comparison operator is on its own line (marker there)
DATE parameter compared with a numeric literal, deep in an ELSE branch, with a block comment before the operator
NUMBER parameter of a local function compared with a text literal; the local function precedes the main body

negatives.note: TO_DATE with a format mask (nested commas) and with three arguments; 'TO_DATE(p_text)' only in a comment and a string
comparison operators only in comments and strings; '=>' in named-notation calls is not a comparison even between different families
same-family comparisons: text/text, number/number (PLS_INTEGER local), date/date
identifiers merely containing TO_DATE / TO_TIMESTAMP (user function my_to_date, variables l_to_date) are not TO_DATE calls
comparisons inside a searched CASE expression, all between operands of the same family
